concerns.text: SC-003 adds a new quantitative success criterion – a model trained on the top‑5 SHAP‑ranked descriptors must achieve R² ≥ 0.50 × R²_full – which does not appear in the original idea. The idea only requires overall model performance and a SHAP‑based descriptor ranking; this extra ratio requirement is an unrequested metric and expands the scope.

The acceptance scenario specifies a power‑analysis target of ≥ 3000 matched entries ("[deferred: n≥500, target≥3000]") without providing an effect‑size justification. The idea mentions a curated ~5 k entry subset but never mandates a concrete entry‑count target; imposing this number adds work beyond the original scope.

The spec references an `aligned_dataset.schema.yaml` that disallows any properties beyond a minimal list (additionalProperties: false), yet the functional requirements (FR‑001‑007) expect many extra columns (e.g., p_band_center, bader_charges, reaction_energy, coordination_number). This creates a contradictory requirement that would prevent the pipeline from producing the needed dataset, representing an over‑reach relative to the idea’s data model.
